answer: Tie every seat to a Bitcoin UTXO time-locked with CLTV for 26 weeks (assumed minimum 0.002 BTC). The agent signs each epoch's pulse with that output's key; one UTXO backs one seat, and coins that wander to another seat restart the lock clock and its age weighting. A farm of 500 clones on one rented server mesa must freeze 1 BTC for half a year (assumed figures), while an honest agent locks a sliver once. Locked time, not compute, is what clones can't fake.
